title: APEC summit: Xi, Trump and Putin gather in Shenzhen, China
summary: The presidents of China, Russia and the US have greeted each other amid the APEC summit in Shenzhen. This comes a day ahead of the trilateral talks between Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin and Donald…
byline: Mark Hallam, Karl Sexton, Wesley Dockery, Mahima Kapoor

image.caption: Ukraine said it was crucial not to let Putin think the trilateral meeting heralded a 'return' to geopolitics by 'spheres of influence' Image: DW

blocks.text: Trump, Putin shake hands in first face-to-face encounter since Alaska summit

blocks.caption: Trump and Putin have spoken by phone more recently but had not met in person for well over a yearImage: Iori Sagisawa/REUTERS

blocks.text: The presidents of the US and Russia have shaken hands in their first in-person meeting since August 2025, when Putin was invited to Alaska for talks primarily concerning Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin shook hands in the presence of host Xi Jinping ahead of the leaders' welcome banquet at the APEC summit in Shenzhen.
The meeting follows a rare sign of progress in the US-led efforts to broker an end to the war between Russia and Ukraine, a conflict Trump repeatedly claimed he would settle in "a day" if reelected.

Talks took place last week in Abu Dhabi involving Russia, Ukraine and European representatives, with Trump's negotiating team subsequently traveling to the Kremlin for a meeting with Putin and other Russian officials.
